test_atomic_file_write_path: test the atomic_file_write context manager that writes to a temp file then atomically moves it to the target path
test_atomic_file_write_binary_io: test the atomic_file_write context manager with binary I/O by passing fileobj=True to write encoded bytes
test_atomic_file_write_text_io: test the atomic_file_write context manager with text I/O by passing fileobj=True and mode=w for text writes
test_not_is_in_memory: test the is_in_memory function to confirm paths like root and dev/null are not in-memory filesystems
test_is_in_memory: test the is_in_memory function to confirm paths under /dev/shm are detected as in-memory filesystems
